# Supplemental IDN confusable skeleton mappings (`ExtraConf`, `und-t-und-x0-xconf`).
# Exclusively used by //components/url_formatter/spoof_checks/skeleton_generator.cc
# for URL spoof checks; do not reuse from other components.
#
# Tests for these mappings live in
# //components/url_formatter/spoof_checks/idn_spoof_checker_unittest.cc
# (plus a basic smoke test in //base/i18n/transliterator_unittest.cc).
#
# IMPORTANT: Adding a digit-lookalike? Add it to `digit_lookalikes_` in
# //components/url_formatter/spoof_checks/idn_spoof_checker.cc, too.
#
# After editing this file, regenerate baked ICU4X data via:
#   python3 tools/crates/run_icu4x_datagen.py generate
# While the legacy `!BUILDFLAG(BUILD_RUST_TRANSLIT)` ICU4C fallback remains in
# //base/i18n/transliterator.cc, keep `CustomRulesForBcp47Id` in sync as well.

# Letter confusables:
# {U+00E6 (æ), U+04D5 (ӕ)} => "ae"
[æӕ] > ae;
# {U+03FC (ϼ), U+048F (ҏ)} => p
[ϼҏ] > p;
# {U+0127 (ħ), U+043D (н), U+045B (ћ), U+04A3 (ң), U+04A5 (ҥ),
#  U+04C8 (ӈ), U+04CA (ӊ), U+050B (ԋ), U+0527 (ԧ), U+0529 (ԩ)} => h
[ħнћңҥӈӊԋԧԩ] > h;
# {U+0138 (ĸ), U+03BA (κ), U+043A (к), U+049B (қ), U+049D (ҝ),
#  U+049F (ҟ), U+04A1 (ҡ), U+04C4 (ӄ), U+051F (ԟ)} => k
[ĸκкқҝҟҡӄԟ] > k;
# {U+014B (ŋ), U+043F (п), U+0525 (ԥ), U+0E01 (ก), U+05D7 (ח)} => n
# TODO(crbug.com/40091387): Handle multiple skeletons for U+0525 and U+0153.
[ŋпԥกח] > n;
# {U+0167 (ŧ), U+0442 (т), U+04AD (ҭ), U+050F (ԏ), U+4E03 (七),
#  U+4E05 (丅), U+4E06 (丆), U+4E01 (丁)} => t
[ŧтҭԏ七丅丆丁] > t;
# {U+0185 (ƅ), U+044C (ь), U+048D (ҍ), U+0432 (в), U+00DF (ß)} => b
[ƅьҍвß] > b;
# {U+03C9 (ω), U+0448 (ш), U+0449 (щ), U+0E1E (พ), U+0E1F (ฟ),
#  U+0E9E (ພ), U+0E9F (ຟ)} => w
[ωшщพฟພຟ] > w;
# {U+043C (м), U+04CE (ӎ)} => m
[мӎ] > m;
# {U+0454 (є), U+04BD (ҽ), U+04BF (ҿ), U+1054 (ၔ)} => e
[єҽҿၔ] > e;
# U+0491 (ґ) => r
ґ > r;
# {U+0493 (ғ), U+04FB (ӻ)} => f
[ғӻ] > f;
# {U+04AB (ҫ), U+1004 (င)} => c
[ҫင] > c;
# {U+04B1 (ұ), U+4E2B (丫)} => y
[ұ丫] > y;
# {U+03C7 (χ), U+04B3 (ҳ), U+04FD (ӽ), U+04FF (ӿ), U+4E42 (乂)} => x
[χҳӽӿ乂] > x;
# {U+0503 (ԃ), U+10EB (ძ)} => d
[ԃძ] > d;
# {U+050D (ԍ), U+100C (ဌ)} => g
[ԍဌ] > g;
# {U+0D1F (ട), U+0E23 (ร), U+0EA3 (ຣ), U+0EAE (ຮ)} => s
[ടรຣຮ] > s;
# U+1042 (၂) => j
၂ > j;
# {U+0966 (०), U+09E6 (০), U+0A66 (੦), U+0AE6 (૦), U+0B20 (ଠ),
#  U+0B66 (୦), U+0CE6 (೦), U+1005 (စ)} => o
[०০੦૦ଠ୦೦စ] > o;
# {U+09ED (৭), U+0A67 (੧), U+0AE7 (૧)} => q
[৭੧૧] > q;
# {U+045F (џ), U+0E1A (บ), U+0E9A (ບ)} => u
[џบບ] > u;

# Digit confusables:
# {U+03B8 (θ)} => 0
[θ] > 0;
# {U+0968 (२), U+09E8 (২), U+0A68 (੨), U+0AE8 (૨), U+0CE9 (೩),
#  U+0CED (೭), U+0577 (շ)} => 2
[२২੨੨૨೩೭շ] > 2;
# {U+0437 (з), U+0499 (ҙ), U+04E1 (ӡ), U+0909 (उ), U+0993 (ও),
#  U+0A24 (ਤ), U+0A69 (੩), U+0AE9 (૩), U+0C69 (౩), U+1012 (ဒ),
#  U+10D5 (ვ), U+10DE (პ), U+0A5C (ੜ), U+10D9 (კ)} => 3
[зҙӡउওਤ੩૩౩ဒვპੜკ] > 3;
# {U+0A6B (੫), U+4E29 (丩), U+3110 (ㄐ)} => 4
[੫丩ㄐ] > 4;
# U+0573 (ճ) => 6
[ճ] > 6;
# {U+09EA (৪), U+0A6A (੪), U+0B6B (୫)} => 8
[৪੪୫] > 8;
# {U+0AED (૭), U+0B68 (୨), U+0C68 (౨)} => 9
[૭୨౨] > 9;

# Dash confusables:
# Map a few dashes that ICU doesn't map. These are already blocked by ICU,
# but mapping them allows us to detect same skeletons.
# {U+2014 (—), U+4E00 (一), U+2015 (―), U+2E3A (⸺), U+2E3B (⸻)} => -
[—一―⸺⸻] > \-;
